text:
kevin: Quick check  planning our X + LinkedIn rollout for the "Ignite" benchmark next Wed. Goal: social -> webinar signups. Need copy + hero GIF + routing by Tue EOD. Thoughts?

lina: Love it. Proposal: single-day cascade: AM X hook (short thread), LinkedIn longform mid-morning, PM deep-dive thread with chart.

zoe: For headline metric let's pick one clear, defensible claim. My vote: "~35% lower cost per response" (bench-ready). If legal okays.

kevin: Alternative for eng audience: "p95 < 40ms". We'll A/B test headlines. Lina, can you own variants?

lina: Yep. I'll draft Variant A (cost-first) and Variant B (latency-first).

ops-bot: HubSpot form created -> https://hooks.example.com/hubspot/ignite-2026. Shortlink: https://go.redwood.ai/ignite1 (tracks utm_source=social). Hidden field campaign_variant added. Test note: please do not share internal bench files in posts.

zoe: Assets needed: hero GIF (16:9), 1200x628 thumbnail, alt text, and 3 tweet-length copy variants. Design, can you confirm timelines?

kevin: Design needs assets by Tue noon to QA. If delayed, we push launch 48h.

design: GIF rough Mon, final Tue morning. Thumbnails + alt text Tue AM.

ads-team: Recommend $800 day-of paid split: 60% AM hook / 40% PM deep-dive. Target: platform engs, infra PMs in NA. Conversion = form submit.

sdr-bot: Routing: immediate Slack ping to #sdr-inbound for each signup + daily CSV at 8:30am. Flag leads who clicked GIF as "hot-engage".

lina: Copy draft (short): "Cut inference cost ~35% for common prompts. See our benchmark + webinar: https://go.redwood.ai/ignite1 #RedwoodInference"

zoe: I'll QA the claim vs bench and sign off before posting. No publish until I OK.

kevin: Great. I'll make a Notion checklist and tag owners. Ping here when assets land. :rocket:
